findings.title: Cross-request detection is disabled — secrets split across multiple requests will not be reassembled

findings.title: Git protection is disabled — pre-push secret scans and command gating are inactive

findings.title: Live-lock contracts are disabled — agent behavior drift is not gated

findings.title: Mediation envelope is disabled — no federation verification of inbound or signed receipts on outbound

findings.remediation: Enable sandbox mode with `sandbox: {enabled: true}` in your pipelock config.

checks.name: config_valid
checks.detail: Config validated with warnings: tls_interception: TLS interception is disabled while the forward proxy accepts CONNECT tunnels. HTTPS traffic is not decrypted, so content scanning (request_body_scanning, response_scanning, path/query entropy, and body DLP) does not inspect HTTPS request paths, bodies, or responses. Pipelock still enforces controls that evaluate from CONNECT metadata or tunnel accounting (destination allowlist/blocklist, SSRF on the CONNECT host, rate limits, data budget, CONNECT handshake-header DLP, kill switch, and receipt gates); request_policy and contract rules that match inner HTTPS method, path, query, headers, or body require tls_interception. Enable tls_interception (and distribute its CA) to scan HTTPS content, or accept tunnel-level-only visibility for HTTPS content as a deliberate posture.
